  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {

```python
# safe_parse pseudocode
try:
  out = validate_with_schema(resp_text, schema)
except ValidationError:
  out = try_envelope_parse(resp_text)
  if not out:
    out = fallback_search(resp_text)
return out
```
